input.content: """Characterization tests for Scripts/systems.py. These tests pin down the current behaviour of ``generate_markdown_tables``: the Markdown structure it emits, its manufacturer/year sort order, and the BIOS anchor/link generation. They exercise the module in-process (via ``capsys``) so no external plist fixture is required. """ import os import plistlib import sys import tempfile import pytest sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__)) import systems # noqa: E402 def _write_plist(data): fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".plist") with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as f: plistlib.dump(data, f) return path @pytest.fixture def sample_plist(): data = [ # Deliberately out of order to verify sorting. { "PVSystemName": "PlayStation", "PVManufacturer": "Sony", "PVReleaseYear": 1994, "PVBit": "32", "PVUsesCDs": True, "PVRequiresBIOS": True, "PVBIOSNames": [ { "Name": "scph5501.bin", "MD5": "8dd7d5296a650fac7319bce665a6a53c", "Description": "PS1 BIOS", "Optional": False, } ], }, { "PVSystemName": "Game Boy", "PVManufacturer": "Nintendo", "PVReleaseYear": "1989", "PVBit": "8", "PVPortable": True, "PVRequiresBIOS": False, "PVBIOSNames": [], }, ] path = _write_plist(data) yield path os.unlink(path) def _run(path, capsys): systems.generate_markdown_tables(path) return capsys.readouterr().out def test_headers_present(sample_plist, capsys): out = _run(sample_plist, capsys) assert "# Emulator Systems Overview" in out assert "## System Features" in out assert "## BIOS Requirements" in out assert "Generated with" in out def test_sorted_by_manufacturer_then_year(sample_plist, capsys): out = _run(sample_plist, capsys) # Nintendo (Game Boy) sorts before Sony (PlayStation). assert out.index("| Game Boy |") < out.index("| PlayStation |") def test_boolean_flags_rendered_as_checkmarks(sample_plist, capsys): out = _run(sample_plist, capsys) assert "| Game Boy | Nintendo | 1989 | 8 | ✓ | ✗ | ✗ |" in out # PlayStation uses CDs and requires BIOS (linked checkmark). assert "[✓](#bios-playstation)" in out def test_bios_entry_and_md5_link(sample_plist, capsys): out = _run(sample_plist, capsys) assert '' in out assert "scph5501.bin" in out assert ( "https://www.google.com/search?q=8dd7d5296a650fac7319bce665a6a53c" in out ) def test_year_sort_handles_missing_release_year(capsys): # A missing PVReleaseYear must default to 0 rather than raising. data = [ {"PVSystemName": "Mystery", "PVManufacturer": "Acme"}, {"PVSystemName": "Later", "PVManufacturer": "Acme", "PVReleaseYear": "2000"}, ] path = _write_plist(data) try: out = _run(path, capsys) finally: os.unlink(path) assert out.index("| Mystery |") < out.index("| Later |")
